name: Telok Blangah
summary: CCL / harbour-adjacent ridge — park connectors, older estate and condo mix, and shorter harbour hops than far-west towns.
body: Telok Blangah is the shortlist when Circle Line / harbour-adjacent access and greener ridge walking matter more than CBD-south office crush. Housing mixes mature HDB, walk-ups, and condo inserts toward HarbourFront / Henderson; weekend park-connector traffic and hill humidity are the tax. Expats land here for car-light living with Mount Faber / Southern Ridges adjacency and rents that still undercut Quayside. Compare with Redhill for denser EWL hawker texture, HarbourFront for mall / ferry gravity, and Queenstown when you want a more classic west-of-CBD estate grid.
